suppressions.evidence: Tauri 1.8.3 reaches quick-xml through plist and Windows notification support. MediaSorter does not parse user-controlled XML through either dependency; plist input is build-owned and notification XML is generated, not parsed. Upgrade is blocked until a compatible Tauri 1 transitive release adopts quick-xml 0.41 or MediaSorter completes its separately reviewed Tauri migration.
